title: The Real Price of Healthcare with Mark Cuban

reader_summary.headline: When you look at healthcare, the first thing you think is we hate it.
reader_summary.overview: When you look at healthcare, the first thing you think is we hate it. The second thing you think is no one can figure it out. You know how much you spend on health care, but you have no idea what you're spending it on.

key_points.text: You have no idea why it costs, what it costs.
key_points.evidence_quote: You have no idea why it costs, what it costs.

key_points.text: You know how much we've spent on marketing and advertising?
key_points.evidence_quote: You know how much we've spent on marketing and advertising?

key_points.text: Because transparency is the best salesperson ever.
key_points.evidence_quote: Because transparency is the best salesperson ever.

key_points.text: Of all the businesses I've ever started in my entire life, this has been the easiest.
